Amentum is seeking a Software Engineer to join its DevOps team supporting mission-focused cyber training solutions in Hanover, Maryland. The role assists with software development, testing, deployment, maintenance, infrastructure, and operational support across a diverse portfolio of applications and environments under the guidance of senior engineers.
Mechanical Engineering
Security
Technical Support
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Assist in developing, troubleshooting, testing, and maintaining software applications supporting cyber training environments
Assist with implementing technical solutions based on established requirements
Develop software components, scripts, APIs, and user interface enhancements under guidance
Support the operation and maintenance of software development pipelines
Assist with application deployment and environment configuration
Contribute to databases, scripts, automation, and data processing solutions
Support the creation and maintenance of realistic cyber training environments and simulations
Perform software testing, debugging, validation, and analysis of results
Document software designs, configurations, processes, and operational procedures
Collaborate with instructors, developers, system administrators, and other technical teams to improve training capabilities
Recommend improvements to applications and workflows
Develops familiarity with team applications, services, and deployment processes
Implements software changes with guidance from senior engineers
Builds foundational skills across development, testing, and deployment activities
Write maintainable code and supporting documentation, contributing across multiple projects
Developing software using modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Go, React, Angular, or similar technologies
Developing or supporting web applications, backend services, APIs, or databases using SQL or NoSQL technologies
Software development practices including source control, automated testing, and debugging
Linux or Windows operating systems, scripting, virtualization, container technologies, or cloud-native concepts
Automation, CI/CD, or DevOps tools through academic, personal, or professional experience
Demonstrate a willingness to learn new technologies
Collaborate effectively with teammates
Produce maintainable, well-documented code
Grow technical knowledge across the software development lifecycle
Communicate effectively with technical team members
Adapt to changing priorities and mission needs
Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams
Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities
Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job
